title: An Inverse Source Problem For a Time-Fractional Mixed Wave-Diffusion-Wave Equation in a Cylindrical Domain
summary: This paper addresses the inverse source problem for a mixed-type fractional wave-diffusion-wave equation posed in a cylindrical domain. The governing equation involves a time-dependent variable-order fractional derivative, which enables the model to effectively capture temporal transitions between wave-like and diffusive behaviors. The solution is constructed in the form of a Fourier-Bessel series.
